newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gle des Eaux rises on telecoms outlook.
newsitem.headline: Gle des Eaux rises on telecoms outlook.

text.p: Shares in Generale des Eaux rose strongly on the Paris bourse after an analysts meeting in which the company gave a bullish view of the outlook for its telecoms operations, analysts said on Wednesday.
The stock was up 2.7 percent at 570 francs at 1108 GMT with 236,000 shares changing hands.

One analyst quoted chairman Jean-Marie Messier as saying he expected the growth market in telecoms to generate an operating surplus for the group of possibly three billion francs in 1997 and more than three, possibly four billion francs for 1998, on the back of turnover in the region of 13 billion francs.

On September 26, Generale des Eaux announced the creation of Cegetel, an international telecoms grouping in which it would have 50 percent directly and indirectly, with the rest held by British Telecom, SBC and Mannesmann.
